questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers in the set share the same relationship as the numbers in the given set.

(25, 19, 36)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

**(1st Number – 2ⁿd number)² = 3rd Number**

**In **(25, 19, 36)

**(1st Number – 2ⁿd number)²**

(25 - 19)²

= 6²

= 36 **= 3rd Number**

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) **(27, 11, 38)

**(1st Number – 2ⁿd number)²**

(27 - 11)²

= 16²

= 256 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (2) **(24, 22, 49)

**(1st Number – 2ⁿd number)²**

(24 - 22)²

= 2²

= 4 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (3) **(22, 17, 25)

**(1st Number – 2ⁿd number)²**

**(22 - 17)²**

**= 5²**

**= 25 = 3rd Number**

**Option (4) **(20, 14, 66)

**(1st Number – 2ⁿd number)²**

(20 - 14)²

= 6²

= 36 ≠** 3rd Number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****(22, 17, 25)****".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(21, 13, 17)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

**(1st Number + 2ⁿd number) ÷ 2 = 3rd Number**

**In **(21, 13, 17)

**(1st Number + 2ⁿd number) ÷ 2**

= (21 + 13) ÷ 2

= 34 ÷ 2

= 17 **= 3rd Number**

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) **(22, 57, 81)

(1st Number + 2ⁿd number) ÷ 2

= (22 + 57) ÷ 2

= 79 ÷ 2

= 39.5 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (2) **(11, 21, 140)

(1st Number + 2ⁿd number) ÷ 2

= (11 + 21) ÷ 2

= 32 ÷ 2

= 16 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (3) **(25, 35, 38)

(1st Number + 2ⁿd number) ÷ 2

= (25 + 35) ÷ 2

= 60 ÷ 2

= 30 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (4) **(32, 46, 39)

**(1st Number + 2ⁿd number) ÷ 2**

**= (32 + 46) ÷ 2**

**= 78 ÷ 2**

**= 39 = 3rd Number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****(32, 46, 39)****".**

questions.question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic is here is:

**(1st number)³ + 5 = 2ⁿd number.**

Option (1): 5 : 130

Now, follow the logic:

**(5)³ + 5** = 125 + 5 = 130 = 2ⁿd number

This option follows the pattern.

**Option (2):** 8 : 516

**Now, follow the logic:**

**(8)³ + 5** **= 512 + 5 = 517** **≠ 2ⁿd number**

**This option do not follow the pattern.**

Option (3): 9 : 734

Now, follow the logic:

**(9)³ + 5** = 729 + 5 = 734 = 2ⁿd number

This option follows the pattern.

Option (4): 7 : 348

Now, follow the logic:

**(7)³ + 5** = 343 + 5 = 348 = 2ⁿd number

This option follows the pattern.

Hence, pair **“****8 : 516**”**** is an odd one.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

H _ Z _ H O Z C H O _ D _ O _ E H _ Z F

options.text: O B H O Z O
H B Z H H O
O C Z H Z H
O B Z H Z O

questions.solution:
Given :- H _ Z _ H O Z C H O _ D _ O _ E H _ Z F

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

**1): **O B H O Z O → H **__O__** Z **__B__** **/** H O Z C **/** H O **__H__** D **/** **__O__** O **__Z__** E **/** H **__O__** Z F

**2): **H B Z H H O → H **__H__** Z **__B__** **/** H O Z C **/** H O **__Z__** D **/** **__H__** O **__H__** E **/** H **__O__** Z F

**3):** O C Z H Z H → H **__O__** Z **__C__** **/** H O Z C **/** H O **__Z__** D **/** **__H__** O **__Z__** E **/** H **__H__** Z F

**4): O B Z H Z O** → H **__O__** Z **__B__** **/** H O Z C **/** H O **__Z__** D **/** **__H__** O **__Z__** E **/** H **__O__** Z F

 
• **Here last letter of the word is increasing by +1.**

** ♦ B + 1 = C, C + 1 = D, D + 1 = E, E + 1 = F.**

 
• Option (4) gives a pattern of H O Z **B** - H O Z **C** - H O Z **D** - H O Z **E** - H O Z **F**.

Hence**, ‘****O B Z H Z O****’** is the correct answer

questions.question:
**Direction:** Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some drivers are artists.

All fathers are artists.

No father is a doctor.

**Conclusions:**

I. No doctor is an artist.

II. No driver is a doctor.

III. Some artists are fathers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some drivers are artists.

All fathers are artists.

No father is a doctor.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9abb54252e44113bae3a52f670df11579a15c83d78c8504fd96685414879c841.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No doctor is an artist → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. No driver is a doctor → False (It is possible but not definite)

III. Some artists are fathers → True (because all fathers are artists so some artists are also fathers)

Hence, “Only conclusions III follows”.

questions.question: In a group of 72 actors, each artist participates in three activities, viz., quiz, solo acting, and simulation. 11 actors participate in quiz only, 15 participate in solo acting only and 14 participate in simulation only. If 5 artists participate in all the three activities, then calculate the number of artists participating in any two activities.
questions.solution:
Given:

Total number of actors = 72

11 actors participate in quiz only.

15 participate in solo acting only.

14 participate in simulation only.

5 artists participate in all the three activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/597428fdfec788a4bfb8d553b4764ef86a5d65923e55b4bd0c2c23f6d3eb1a9c.png] 

We know that,

**Total number of actors = participate only in quiz, solo acting, and simulation + participate in all the three activities + participating in any two activities**

=> 72 = (11 + 15 + 14) + 5 + (a + b + c)

=> 72 = 40 + 5 + (a + b + c)

=> (a + b + c) = 72 - 40 – 5

 => (a + b + c) = 72 - 45

**=> (a + b + c) = 27**

Hence, **“27****” **number of artists participating in any two activities.
